venue.name: Cottiers
venue.description: A stunning converted church in the leafy West End neighbourhood of Hyndland. Cottiers’ intimate theatre space hosts a varied programme of comedy, music, theatre, and community events beneath original stained glass windows. The venue also houses a popular bar and restaurant — perfect for a pre-show drink.

concessions.summary: Cottiers publishes a single standard price per event and no venue-wide concession scheme. Ticket queries go to the theatre directly.
